tools.description: Create or overwrite a file in the project workspace. Path is relative to the workspace root (e.g. Putnam/Helper.lean). Parent directories are created automatically.
tools.name: write_file

tools.description: Read a file from the workspace (relative path).
tools.name: read_file

tools.description: List the workspace tree (paths relative to the root).
tools.name: list_dir

tools.description: Run `lake build` at the workspace root and return its full output (all errors across all files).
tools.name: lake_build

tools.description: Check the workspace AGAINST THE ACCEPTANCE GATE'S rules before you declare the project done: (1) scans every .lean file for forbidden tokens (sorry, admit, axiom, native_decide, set_option, run_tac, run_cmd, #eval, #exit, unsafe, implemented_by, extern, ofReduceBool, ofReduceNat, sorryAx, addDecl, addDeclWithoutChecking, +native — these REJECT the submission even if the build passes); (2) runs a clean `lake build`. Call this before replying DONE and fix everything it reports.
tools.name: verify
